notes.title: Huge update for Zombie Road Rider! New maps and new zombies!
notes.notes:
Hi people!

Zombie Road Rider has received a huge update that was on the work for some times now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1175640/Zombie_Road_Rider/

Actually, the game has received a series of updates since the last news that was posted last year ago! So what is new?

A full new environment to play! The City Downtown ! Set in an environment made of skyscrapers and large roads, save the survivors who are running around and bring them to the safe house!

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/95a0d1b7264481b6ac5e137bf3a7d2fe666b76aa.jpg

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/8f4e97a8c6bfae9a50ea725db8a7de4d3c9d0064.jpg

Another new environment, the Industrial Town! Set in narrow streets with old industrial style buildings, largely populated with fully physics-based props, obstacles and zombies to road ride!

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/98f1e6fe837711a742a3775547dfccf23bc79310.jpg

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/fee8a8ddef73791dcacdc55f7d52fc7fca266e03.jpg

The Factory, a modern industrial type place with barricades and zombies to destroy!

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/ade6a5df7052809be50173755ebab3f195d6ac41.jpg

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/a7e51c4dc1321136d3d203c7e5a49f4ee1aa8802.jpg

Another one main new aspect of the game is that +30 zombies were added to replace the old classic one, so that the game has more variety of characters!

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/d026c4dfa1436d565e546f9a344a423bbf313c46.jpg

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/79c36fe1d10ef8ab1a5221af2a1626267cdd9578.jpg

Physics of the cars and vehicles were reworked to feel more enjoyable and powerful against the obstacles and zombies on the road. Improvements were made on the graphics and the optimisation of the game to have it run more smoothly. The menu and user interface was also reworked to be more intuitive and easier to use.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0qe6t-gvPVg

The environments that were added have support for both rescue and freeride game mode!

So this pretty sum up all what you will find in this large update! I hope you will enjoy!

Best,
Devdan

notes.title: Gameplay Update for Action Alien Tropical (April 2020)
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/d0667a79ac504f4facd74dbe04aba3cc9af4d55e.png

This week an update has been pushed for the game which provides :

Changes in the gameplay. 

 Ammo and bombs are now located in the islands. This gives more ability to complete the game by searching the islands!
 Aliens will now spawn differently on the islands. Some of them will be roaming around while others will be rushing at you!
 Changes with the ambient music and fix for sounds effects
 Fix for the aliens soldiers AI
 Changes in the HUD map display
 ...


Optimization

 Optimization for the islands, bungalows and foliage which result in an increase of FPS!


Fix for Steam achievements being unlocked the wrong way!


https://store.steampowered.com/app/810800/Action_Alien_Tropical
More updates may come in the future, when needing to fix some issues or simply to improve the game !

Best!
Devdan

notes.title: Update and bug fixes for Action Alien Tropical Mayhem
notes.notes:
A small update has been released for Action Alien Tropical Mayhem to address some issues with the game along adding improvements for the gameplay.

What was fixed is the kind of black hole under the water which were sometimes appearing during the game.

The aliens placements on the islands were also improved so that they can better reach you when you enter or exit an island with the boat.

Subtitles and texts from help screens were also checked to make them more helpful and clear from grammar misspelling.

A feature which was added is the ability to skip the introduction sequence by pressing the space bar.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/94e458d2ef39791f624ab434c118f34f8e9c3abf.jpg

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/f119960cad1f262cb8c6690eaa661812c0a22829.jpg

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/b13d5830697203ae945f6f27ab8307b7bdf979d7.jpg

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/24967dc1aa0cf2a2c14aae1c0d0bf6606d7dd9f9.jpg

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/e87392551433f1d2549029f5524a649624a5072a.jpg

The background picture of the menu was also replaced by dynamic in-game sequences.

After making all these changes, the trailer of the game was remade and you can watch it here !

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Q1XTaql5ve4
Change log :

 Fixed the black hole bug appearing under the water
 Fixed aliens trigger zones
 Fixed HUD stats not being initialized at the start of a game
 Fixed some spelling mistakes on the texts and subtitles
 Replaced picture background with a dynamic animated background
 Added ability to skip the introduction sequences
 Fixed some bugs with the achievements
 Remade the game's icon
 New trailer
 Fixed the loading screen bad ratio size


Apart from the game, you can also check the website http://devdangames.com which was entirely redesigned and see all other games !

Thanks for reading,
Devdan
